name: @merit/api
description: The /api/v1 surface API_CONTRACT specifies. Railway services: api (public origin) and api-admin (ADMIN_ORIGIN), one codebase deployed twice per ADR-083.
//: IT DECLARES NO RUNTIME DEPENDENCY, AND FASTIFY'S ABSENCE HERE IS THE FENCE RATHER THAN THE RULING. ADR-083 rules the framework; the version lives in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`'s `catalog:` block, which this session does not hold (P3 build plan section 6 gives it to sessions 145 and 147), and `.npmrc`'s `save-exact` plus VG-12 make a version a human approves once rather than a caret. So the manifest that would carry `"fastify": "catalog:"` carries nothing, and the shell is the four existing apps' shape: real structure, no wiring. THERE IS NO `build` SCRIPT AND THERE MUST NOT BE ONE. `CI-06/gate-inventory` probes every apps/*/package.json for that key and requires it ABSENT, because CI-07's row reads through an artifact that does not exist; a build script makes that gate fail on good news. Fastify 5 needs none, which is measured in ADR-083 section 5 rather than assumed.
